pitch_routes.route: Netflix does not accept or review unsolicited material. Pitches must come through a licensed agent, producer, attorney, manager or industry executive with an existing Netflix relationship.

Netflix Documentary Talent Fund (with Sheffield DocFest): teams pitch to a jury; five teams get £30,000 each for an 8-12 minute doc. 2026 cohort announced 10 Jun 2026; no application link in the article.

briefs.title: Netflix UK unscripted chief promises bold originals (Deadline Reality TV Summit UK)
briefs.summary: Syeda Irtizaali says Netflix UK will commission lots of 'audacious' original unscripted ideas, with a debut slate to follow. Aggregator copy of a Jesse Whittock (Deadline) piece.

briefs.title: Netflix eyes unscripted push across EMEA, with formats & docusoaps targeted (TBI)
briefs.summary: Lucy Leveugle: wants local formats that can be adapted elsewhere, docusoaps with standout casts, and docuseries on stories local audiences already know. Undated, probably 2022 - check.

briefs.title: Netflix announces new UK commissions at Edinburgh TV Festival
briefs.summary: Anne Mensah (VP UK Content): 'You need to swing for exceptional.' Unscripted orders were Beat Luke Littler (live darts) and Outside (Sidemen spin-off). No documentaries were announced.
